insights.summary: The agent performed a highly systematic optimization of CUDA kernels. It identified three distinct levels of optimization: utility-level, kernel-level, and build-level. While it couldn't verify the performance gains due to environment constraints, the implemented changes are standard high-performance computing practices that would likely yield the estimated 8-15% improvement.
strengths: Strong understanding of CUDA performance bottlenecks.
Excellent adherence to complex task constraints and iteration limits.
weaknesses: Inability to bypass or mock CUDA requirements for basic syntax checking of kernels.
Reliance on fast-math which may affect numerical stability in sensitive models.
